sourcePolicy: Primary sources only (statutes, EU acts, official gazettes, DSK/DPA and federal agency material). Entries with type 'guidance' (case law, proceedings status) may support but never solely justify a rule.

sources.title: § 5 DDG – Allgemeine Informationspflichten
sources.publisher: Bundesministerium der Justiz und für Verbraucherschutz / juris (gesetze-im-internet.de)
sources.establishes: Impressum duty for commercial digital services (successor of § 5 TMG since 14.05.2024): name/address, legal form + representative for legal persons, e-mail and fast electronic contact, supervisory authority, register + number, chamber/professional title/rules, USt-IdNr or W-IdNr, liquidation, AVMS data; must be easily recognisable, directly reachable, permanently available.

sources.title: § 6 DDG – Besondere Pflichten bei kommerziellen Kommunikationen
sources.publisher: Bundesministerium der Justiz und für Verbraucherschutz / juris (gesetze-im-internet.de)
sources.establishes: Commercial communications must be recognisable as such, the commissioning party identifiable, promotional offers/contests and their conditions clearly stated; no concealment of sender/commercial nature in e-mail header/subject.

sources.title: § 18 Medienstaatsvertrag (MStV) – Informationspflichten und Auskunftsrechte (Text gilt ab 01.12.2025)
sources.publisher: Bayerische Staatskanzlei (BAYERN.RECHT, amtliches Landesrechtsportal)
sources.establishes: Abs. 1: all telemedia not exclusively personal/family purposes must show name and address (legal persons: also name/address of representative). Abs. 2: journalistic-editorial offers must additionally name a responsible person (name + address) meeting residence/capacity criteria; several responsible persons need their parts marked.

sources.title: § 2 DL-InfoV – Stets zur Verfügung zu stellende Informationen
sources.publisher: Bundesministerium der Justiz und für Verbraucherschutz / juris (gesetze-im-internet.de)
sources.establishes: Service providers must provide name/Firma with legal form, address, contact (in particular phone and e-mail or fax), register, competent authority for licensed activities, USt-IdNr, regulated profession title/state/chamber, AGB, choice-of-law clauses, guarantees, main features and professional liability insurance (insurer name/address, territorial scope); may be fulfilled electronically.

sources.title: § 37a HGB – Angaben auf Geschäftsbriefen des Kaufmanns
sources.publisher: Bundesministerium der Justiz und für Verbraucherschutz / juris (gesetze-im-internet.de)
sources.establishes: Business letters of a Kaufmann (any form, incl. e-mail) to a specific recipient must state Firma, designation per § 19 Abs. 1 Nr. 1 HGB (e.K.), place of business, register court and HR number; order forms (Bestellscheine) count as business letters.

sources.title: § 125 HGB – Angaben auf Geschäftsbriefen (OHG/KG)
sources.publisher: Bundesministerium der Justiz und für Verbraucherschutz / juris (gesetze-im-internet.de)
sources.establishes: Business letters of OHG/KG must state Firma, seat, register court and HR number; if no partner is a natural person (e.g. GmbH & Co. KG), also the partners' names and their § 35a GmbHG / § 80 AktG data.

sources.title: § 35a GmbHG – Angaben auf Geschäftsbriefen
sources.publisher: Bundesministerium der Justiz und für Verbraucherschutz / juris (gesetze-im-internet.de)
sources.establishes: GmbH (incl. UG) business letters/order forms: legal form, seat, register court, HR number, all managing directors and the supervisory board chair (surname + at least one written-out first name); if capital is mentioned, Stammkapital and outstanding cash contributions.

sources.title: § 5a GmbHG – Unternehmergesellschaft
sources.publisher: Bundesministerium der Justiz und für Verbraucherschutz / juris (gesetze-im-internet.de)
sources.establishes: A GmbH founded below minimum capital must carry "Unternehmergesellschaft (haftungsbeschränkt)" or "UG (haftungsbeschränkt)" in its Firma.

sources.title: § 80 AktG – Angaben auf Geschäftsbriefen
sources.publisher: Bundesministerium der Justiz und für Verbraucherschutz / juris (gesetze-im-internet.de)
sources.establishes: AG business letters/order forms: legal form, seat, register court, HR number, all board members and supervisory board chair; chair of the board marked as such; capital rules as in GmbHG.

sources.title: § 707a BGB – Eintragung im Gesellschaftsregister (eGbR)
sources.publisher: Bundesministerium der Justiz und für Verbraucherschutz / juris (gesetze-im-internet.de)
sources.establishes: Since MoPeG (01.01.2024) a GbR registered in the Gesellschaftsregister must carry "eingetragene Gesellschaft bürgerlichen Rechts" or "eGbR"; if no natural person is liable, a liability-limitation designation is required.

sources.title: § 139c AO – Wirtschafts-Identifikationsnummer
sources.publisher: Bundesministerium der Justiz und für Verbraucherschutz / juris (gesetze-im-internet.de)
sources.establishes: W-IdNr is allocated on request of the tax authority, starts with "DE"; basis for the W-IdNr disclosure referenced in § 5 Abs. 1 Nr. 6 DDG.

sources.title: Verordnung (EU) 2016/679 (DSGVO), insbesondere Art. 5, 6, 7, 12, 13, 25, 28, 32, 44–49
sources.publisher: Amt für Veröffentlichungen der EU (EUR-Lex)
sources.establishes: GDPR: principles (Art. 5), lawfulness (Art. 6), conditions for consent incl. withdrawal as easy as giving (Art. 7), transparent information (Art. 12/13), privacy by design/default (Art. 25), processors and DPA contracts (Art. 28), security of processing (Art. 32), third-country transfers (Art. 44 ff.).

sources.title: Durchführungsbeschluss (EU) 2023/1795 – Angemessenheit EU-US Data Privacy Framework
sources.publisher: Amt für Veröffentlichungen der EU (EUR-Lex)
sources.establishes: Adequacy decision for US recipients certified under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework; transfers to non-certified US recipients need Art. 46 safeguards (e.g. SCC).

sources.title: EuGH Rs. C-703/25 P (Latombe/Kommission) – Rechtsmittel gegen EuG T-553/23
sources.publisher: Gerichtshof der Europäischen Union (curia.europa.eu)
sources.establishes: Appeal against the General Court judgment of 03.09.2025 upholding the DPF adequacy decision; reported as pending as of mid-2026 (status not verified on curia in this review) – DPF currently valid but at risk.

sources.title: § 25 TDDDG – Schutz der Privatsphäre bei Endeinrichtungen
sources.publisher: Bundesministerium der Justiz und für Verbraucherschutz / juris (gesetze-im-internet.de)
sources.establishes: Storing or accessing information on the end user's device requires informed consent per GDPR, unless strictly necessary for a service explicitly requested by the user or solely for transmitting a message (successor of § 25 TTDSG, renamed 14.05.2024).

sources.title: § 19 TDDDG – Technische und organisatorische Vorkehrungen
sources.publisher: Bundesministerium der Justiz und für Verbraucherschutz / juris (gesetze-im-internet.de)
sources.establishes: Providers of commercial digital services must secure their systems according to the state of the art; explicitly names a recognised secure encryption method as such a measure; users must be able to use services protected against third-party knowledge.

sources.title: Einwilligungsverwaltungsverordnung (EinwV)
sources.publisher: Bundesministerium der Justiz und für Verbraucherschutz / juris (gesetze-im-internet.de)
sources.establishes: EinwV of 06.02.2025 (BGBl. 2025 I Nr. 32), in force 01.04.2025. Regulates recognised consent-management services (PIMS) under § 26 TDDDG; the provider of the digital service remains responsible for information duties and valid consent; use of a recognised service is voluntary.

sources.title: DSK – Orientierungshilfe der Aufsichtsbehörden für Anbieter:innen von digitalen Diensten (OH Digitale Dienste), Version 1.2, November 2024
sources.publisher: Datenschutzkonferenz (DSK)
sources.establishes: Current (verified on the DSK list 2026-11-02, no newer version) joint DPA guidance on § 25 TDDDG and GDPR for websites/apps: when consent is required, consent-banner design (reject option equivalent to accept), embedding third-party content, legal bases for subsequent processing.

sources.title: DSK – Übersicht Orientierungshilfen
sources.publisher: Datenschutzkonferenz (DSK)
sources.establishes: Official list of DSK guidance; used to confirm that OH Digitale Dienste (Nov 2024) is the current version and to monitor new guidance.

sources.title: § 36 VSBG – Allgemeine Informationspflicht
sources.publisher: Bundesministerium der Justiz und für Verbraucherschutz / juris (gesetze-im-internet.de)
sources.establishes: Traders with a website or AGB must state whether they are willing/obliged to take part in consumer arbitration (exempt from Nr. 1 if ≤10 employees on 31.12. of the previous year); if willing/obliged, name the competent body with address and website.

sources.title: § 37 VSBG – Informationen nach Entstehen der Streitigkeit
sources.publisher: Bundesministerium der Justiz und für Verbraucherschutz / juris (gesetze-im-internet.de)
sources.establishes: After an unresolved dispute the trader must inform the consumer in text form about a competent consumer arbitration body and its willingness to participate (applies regardless of size).

sources.title: Verordnung (EU) 2024/3228 – Aufhebung der VO (EU) Nr. 524/2013 (Einstellung der OS-Plattform)
sources.publisher: Amt für Veröffentlichungen der EU (EUR-Lex)
sources.establishes: Regulation 524/2013 repealed with effect from 20.07.2025; ODR platform discontinued (complaints closed 20.03.2025, all data deleted by 20.07.2025). The Art. 14 duty to link the ODR platform no longer exists.

sources.title: § 3 PAngV – Pflicht zur Angabe des Gesamtpreises
sources.publisher: Bundesministerium der Justiz und für Verbraucherschutz / juris (gesetze-im-internet.de)
sources.establishes: Traders offering or advertising with prices to consumers must state total prices (incl. VAT and other components); split prices require the total to be highlighted.

sources.title: § 4 PAngV – Pflicht zur Angabe des Grundpreises
sources.publisher: Bundesministerium der Justiz und für Verbraucherschutz / juris (gesetze-im-internet.de)
sources.establishes: Goods sold by weight/volume/length/area require a unit price next to the total price, with listed exceptions.

sources.title: § 312i BGB – Allgemeine Pflichten im elektronischen Geschäftsverkehr
sources.publisher: Bundesministerium der Justiz und für Verbraucherschutz / juris (gesetze-im-internet.de)
sources.establishes: Online contracts: input-error correction, Art. 246c EGBGB information before order, immediate electronic order confirmation, contract terms incl. AGB retrievable and storable.

sources.title: § 312j BGB – Besondere Pflichten im elektronischen Geschäftsverkehr gegenüber Verbrauchern
sources.publisher: Bundesministerium der Justiz und für Verbraucherschutz / juris (gesetze-im-internet.de)
sources.establishes: B2C online shops: delivery restrictions and accepted payment methods at the latest at the start of ordering; key information directly before the order; order button labelled "zahlungspflichtig bestellen" or equivalent – otherwise no contract.

sources.title: § 312k BGB – Kündigung von Verbraucherverträgen im elektronischen Geschäftsverkehr
sources.publisher: Bundesministerium der Justiz und für Verbraucherschutz / juris (gesetze-im-internet.de)
sources.establishes: If consumers can conclude continuing-obligation contracts on a website, a cancellation button ("Verträge hier kündigen") with confirmation page must be provided.

sources.title: § 356a BGB – Elektronische Widerrufsfunktion bei Fernabsatzverträgen
sources.publisher: Bundesministerium der Justiz und für Verbraucherschutz / juris (gesetze-im-internet.de)
sources.establishes: New since 19.06.2026: distance contracts concluded via an online interface require a permanently available, prominent withdrawal function ("Vertrag widerrufen") with a confirmation step ("Widerruf bestätigen") and an immediate receipt on a durable medium.

sources.title: Gesetz zur Änderung des Verbrauchervertrags- und des Versicherungsvertragsrechts sowie zur Änderung des Behandlungsvertragsrechts, BGBl. 2026 I Nr. 28 vom 05.02.2026
sources.publisher: Bundesministerium der Justiz und für Verbraucherschutz (Bundesgesetzblatt, recht.bund.de)
sources.establishes: Amending act that introduced § 356a BGB (implementation of Directive (EU) 2023/2673); published 05.02.2026.

sources.title: Richtlinie (EU) 2023/2673 – Fernabsatz von Finanzdienstleistungen / Widerrufsfunktion (Art. 11a RL 2011/83/EU)
sources.publisher: Amt für Veröffentlichungen der EU (EUR-Lex)
sources.establishes: Introduced the EU-wide withdrawal function (Art. 11a Consumer Rights Directive); Member State measures apply from 19.06.2026.

sources.title: Art. 246a § 1 EGBGB – Informationspflichten bei Fernabsatzverträgen
sources.publisher: Bundesministerium der Justiz und für Verbraucherschutz / juris (gesetze-im-internet.de)
sources.establishes: Pre-contractual information for distance contracts incl. withdrawal right conditions, deadlines and procedure (model withdrawal form/instructions).

sources.title: Verordnung (EU) 2023/988 über die allgemeine Produktsicherheit (GPSR), Art. 19
sources.publisher: Amt für Veröffentlichungen der EU (EUR-Lex)
sources.establishes: Applies since 13.12.2024. Art. 19: online offers of products must clearly show manufacturer name/trade name, postal and e-mail address, EU responsible person if manufacturer is outside the EU, product identification (incl. picture/type) and warnings/safety information.

sources.title: § 1 BFSG – Zweck und Anwendungsbereich
sources.publisher: Bundesministerium der Justiz und für Verbraucherschutz / juris (gesetze-im-internet.de)
sources.establishes: BFSG applies to listed services provided to consumers after 28.06.2025, incl. "Dienstleistungen im elektronischen Geschäftsverkehr"; excludes e.g. pre-28.06.2025 recorded media, third-party content not controlled by the operator, archives.

sources.title: § 2 BFSG – Begriffsbestimmungen
sources.publisher: Bundesministerium der Justiz und für Verbraucherschutz / juris (gesetze-im-internet.de)
sources.establishes: Nr. 17 Kleinstunternehmen: fewer than 10 employees and annual turnover or balance sheet total ≤ EUR 2 million; Nr. 26 e-commerce services: digital services via websites/apps provided electronically on individual request of a consumer with a view to concluding a consumer contract.

sources.title: § 3 BFSG – Barrierefreiheit (Kleinstunternehmen-Ausnahme Abs. 3)
sources.publisher: Bundesministerium der Justiz und für Verbraucherschutz / juris (gesetze-im-internet.de)
sources.establishes: Products/services must be accessible; Abs. 3 exempts micro-enterprises that provide services (not products) from the accessibility requirements.

sources.title: § 14 BFSG – Pflichten des Dienstleistungserbringers
sources.publisher: Bundesministerium der Justiz und für Verbraucherschutz / juris (gesetze-im-internet.de)
sources.establishes: Service may only be offered if it meets the BFSGV requirements and the Anlage 3 information (how the service meets the requirements) is published in accessible form; keep it as long as the service is offered; corrective action and notification on non-conformity.

sources.title: § 38 BFSG – Übergangsbestimmungen
sources.publisher: Bundesministerium der Justiz und für Verbraucherschutz / juris (gesetze-im-internet.de)
sources.establishes: Transition until 27.06.2030 for services using products lawfully used before 28.06.2025 and for pre-existing service contracts.

sources.title: § 19 BFSGV – Zusätzliche Anforderungen an Dienstleistungen im elektronischen Geschäftsverkehr
sources.publisher: Bundesministerium der Justiz und für Verbraucherschutz / juris (gesetze-im-internet.de)
sources.establishes: E-commerce services must provide accessibility information on products/services offered and make identification, authentication, security and payment functions perceivable, operable, understandable and robust.

sources.title: Bundesfachstelle Barrierefreiheit – Das Barrierefreiheitsstärkungsgesetz (BFSG)
sources.publisher: Bundesfachstelle Barrierefreiheit (bei der Deutschen Rentenversicherung Knappschaft-Bahn-See)
sources.establishes: Official federal information on BFSG scope (products/services since 28.06.2025, micro-enterprise exemption for services), standards, market surveillance and FAQ.

sources.title: § 26 BDSG – Datenverarbeitung für Zwecke des Beschäftigungsverhältnisses
sources.publisher: Bundesministerium der Justiz und für Verbraucherschutz / juris (gesetze-im-internet.de)
sources.establishes: Text unchanged: processing for deciding on establishing employment; consent in employment context. Note: CJEU C-34/21 casts doubt on Abs. 1 S. 1 as an Art. 88 GDPR 'more specific rule' – applicability requires lawyer review; Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR is the usual fallback.

sources.title: EuGH, Urt. v. 30.03.2023, C-34/21 (Hauptpersonalrat der Lehrerinnen und Lehrer)
sources.publisher: Gerichtshof der Europäischen Union (curia.europa.eu)
sources.establishes: National employee-data rules that merely restate GDPR do not qualify under Art. 88 GDPR; relevant to the continued usability of § 26 Abs. 1 S. 1 BDSG.

sources.title: § 11 AGG – Ausschreibung
sources.publisher: Bundesministerium der Justiz und für Verbraucherschutz / juris (gesetze-im-internet.de)
sources.establishes: Job advertisements must not discriminate on grounds listed in § 1 AGG (e.g. sex, age, ethnic origin, religion, disability, sexual identity).

sources.title: § 15 AGG – Entschädigung und Schadensersatz (Frist Abs. 4)
sources.publisher: Bundesministerium der Justiz und für Verbraucherschutz / juris (gesetze-im-internet.de)
sources.establishes: Discrimination claims of rejected applicants must be asserted in writing within two months of receiving the rejection – the main driver for applicant-data retention periods.

sources.title: § 61b ArbGG – Klage wegen Benachteiligung
sources.publisher: Bundesministerium der Justiz und für Verbraucherschutz / juris (gesetze-im-internet.de)
sources.establishes: Action for AGG compensation must be filed within three months after the written claim – relevant to how long applicant data may be kept for defence.

sources.title: § 22 KunstUrhG – Recht am eigenen Bild
sources.publisher: Bundesministerium der Justiz und für Verbraucherschutz / juris (gesetze-im-internet.de)
sources.establishes: Images of persons may only be published with the depicted person's consent (exceptions in § 23 KUG); parallel GDPR requirements for identifiable persons.

sources.title: § 7 UWG – Unzumutbare Belästigungen
sources.publisher: Bundesministerium der Justiz und für Verbraucherschutz / juris (gesetze-im-internet.de)
sources.establishes: E-mail advertising requires prior express consent (Abs. 2 Nr. 2) except the existing-customer exception (Abs. 3); every advertising message needs a valid opt-out address.

sources.title: § 5b UWG – Wesentliche Informationen (Abs. 3 Bewertungen)
sources.publisher: Bundesministerium der Justiz und für Verbraucherschutz / juris (gesetze-im-internet.de)
sources.establishes: Traders that publish consumer reviews must inform whether and how they ensure that reviews come from consumers who actually used/bought the product (Abs. 3); comparison services on ecological/social features must disclose method (Abs. 3a).

sources.title: Anhang zu § 3 Abs. 3 UWG – stets unzulässige geschäftliche Handlungen (Nr. 2a, 4a, 4b, 23b, 23c)
sources.publisher: Bundesministerium der Justiz und für Verbraucherschutz / juris (gesetze-im-internet.de)
sources.establishes: Blacklist incl. sustainability labels not based on certification/public authority (Nr. 2a), unsubstantiated generic environmental claims (Nr. 4a), environmental claims about the whole product/business that only concern part of it (Nr. 4b) – transposition of Directive (EU) 2024/825 now in the consolidated text; unverified claims that reviews stem from real customers (Nr. 23b) and fake reviews (Nr. 23c).

sources.title: EuGH, Urt. v. 10.07.2019, C-649/17 (Amazon EU)
sources.publisher: Gerichtshof der Europäischen Union (curia.europa.eu)
sources.establishes: The 'fast contact' duty does not require a telephone number in every case, but an effective direct communication channel besides e-mail.

sources.title: EuGH, Urt. v. 01.10.2019, C-673/17 (Planet49)
sources.publisher: Gerichtshof der Europäischen Union (curia.europa.eu)
sources.establishes: Pre-ticked boxes do not constitute valid consent for cookies; information on duration and third-party access required.

sources.title: EuGH, Urt. v. 29.07.2019, C-40/17 (Fashion ID)
sources.publisher: Gerichtshof der Europäischen Union (curia.europa.eu)
sources.establishes: Website operators embedding third-party plugins that transmit visitor data are joint controllers for collection and transmission.
